preconditions.description: The number of grooms is between 1 and 100.
The number of times the princess said 'Oh...' and exclaimed 'Wow!' are between 0 and 15.
The total number of grooms seen is greater than the sum of the times she said 'Oh...' and exclaimed 'Wow!'.

postconditions.description: The output sequence has exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 50000 for t_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output sequence is between 1 and 50000.

postconditions.expression: output satisfies the constraints given by a and b
postconditions.description: The output sequence must satisfy the conditions on the number of times the princess said 'Oh...' and exclaimed 'Wow!'.
The output is not -1 if there exists a sequence that satisfies all the constraints.
